construction.material: One word jointly specifies plant, part and state, address m=64*plant+8*part+state in0..4095.
construction.predicate: One following word jointly specifies operation, medium, amount and duration, address v=128*operation+16*medium+4*amount+duration in0..1023.
construction.roles: Alternate material/predicate from explicit paragraph beginning; no reset at physical line wrap. Each complete pair is a fresh portion/instruction, with all seven original fields. No theme carry or missing object. Odd-length paragraphs are illegal.
construction.shared_carrier: Both addresses use the same injective4096-entry ROOTS table already fully defined by1174 src/scribes.py:32prefixes x8heads x4middles x4tails. Equal numeric addresses receive equal whole words even across roles. Role-position selects the decoding dimensions; no free alias, context key, sorting or frequency-trained key.
construction.reverse: Read the two ROOTS addresses, require the second below1024, then divide material by64 and its remainder by8; divide predicate by128, then16, then4. Restore operation,plant,part,state,medium,amount,duration in the exact original order. Only paragraph boundaries and written words are used.
construction.layout: Greedy48-working-sign physical lines using1174 glyph parser; move a whole word intact when it would exceed48, never split it. Paragraph boundaries are explicit. Line wraps are not record boundaries.
construction.example: One portion of dried mint leaves, soak in water overnight: material=(plant0,part0,state1), predicate=(op3,medium1,amount0,duration2), addresses1and402. Next instruction for two portions changes only predicate to406; replacing mint with sage changes material to65. Repeating the complete instruction emits the same pair and means a new portion. These are stipulated teaching indices, never manuscript values.

construction.coverage_limit: This finite language cannot name a65th plant, express arbitrary negation/conditions/reasons, or write an unknown name. No free literal escape is asserted. This ceiling remains even after a statistical pass. It is a finite meaningful control, not a complete open-content reconstruction.

manual_review.ordinary_intelligibility: The first expression identifies the specified material; the second tells what to do to it, with amount, medium and duration. No separate guess from a drawing is needed. Not a claim that the manuscript contains such instructions.
manual_review.whole_repeats: The same address may occur in adjacent roles, or whole instruction pairs may repeat. Therefore the single-REPEAT absolute-SET contradiction is not inherited. No native pair is assigned a value.
manual_review.known_limits: 1218 refutes a strictly alternating class with at most64 whole names. This material class has4096 formal plant/part/state combinations, and cannot claim to pass1218 merely because its upper capacity is larger. No observed native material class is selected.
